name: Induced Subgraph Degree Obfuscation
description: Replaces the direct description of the scheduling conflict (which models easily mapped to a triangle/3-cycle) with an algorithmic audit process. By requiring that each worker in the 3-person group appears in an "even, strictly positive" number of internal incident files, it mathematically forces every worker to have exactly 2 internal files (since the maximum possible in a group of 3 is 2). This perfectly describes a triangle. Pattern-matching models will fail to recognize the triangle and will likely write an $O(n^3)$ simulation that times out, whereas models capable of genuine reasoning will deduce that the degree must be 2, recognize the triangle, and implement the fast $O(nm/64)$ algorithm.
